title: System SQLite FFI connector for Issue 77
intent: Keep PR 78 local-only and eliminate the SQLite wrapper/bundled implementation path: Dactyl must provide the real SQLite connector through a private minimal FFI linked to the host shared libsqlite3, with no rusqlite, libsqlite3-sys, SQLite wrapper crate, or bundled SQLite dependency, while preserving existing SQLite file compatibility, the backend-neutral public API, parameterized values/constraints/read-only/atomic/schema behavior, and the Neon contract.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --check; cargo test --all-features; cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo tree --features sqlite; readelf -d target/debug/deps/*dactyl* | grep sqlite3; decapod validate
stop_conditions: Require a host shared libsqlite3 development/runtime link; do not fall back to bundled SQLite or any SQLite wrapper crate.
